setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|indispon[ií]vel|Algo deu errado|Falha ao|Something went wrong|N[ãa]o conseguimos/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);return 1})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const vis=e=>e.getClientRects().length>0&&getComputedStyle(e).visibility!=='hidden';const nz=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').trim();const rolagem=(el)=>{let c=el.parentElement;while(c&&c!==document.body&&c!==document.documentElement){const s=getComputedStyle(c);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+4)return c;c=c.parentElement;}return document.scrollingElement};const root=document.querySelector("main")||document.body;const el=[...root.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>vis(e)&&nz(e.textContent)==="Plano & m\u00f3dulos"&&![...e.children].some(k=>nz(k.textContent)==="Plano & m\u00f3dulos"))[0];if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const c=rolagem(el);if(!c)return 'SEM ROLAGEM';const dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-140);if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';const y0=c.scrollTop,t0=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/1000),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollTop=y0+dy*e;p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()
